Oxygen centers have five- or six-coordinate geometric environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Li tetrahedra and Nb octahedra, and edge-sharing between Nb octahedra.
